model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between an unspecified variable on the x-axis and informativeness on the y-axis, for two conditions: "w.o. extension" and "extension". The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from 0 to 4, with a linear scale and no units specified, and tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Informativeness" with values ranging from 0.920 to 0.970, also on a linear scale and without units, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 0.010. The plot contains two lines: one blue dashed line with circular markers for "w.o. extension" and one orange solid line with triangular markers for "extension". The blue line starts at approximately 0.968 and ends at approximately 0.923, while the orange line starts at approximately 0.969 and ends at approximately 0.925. Both lines exhibit a steady decline across the x-axis.
